formalConflictDispositions.value: Check each round. The DMG states an Intelligence 12+ minimum, but its spell-user detection table contains lower-Intelligence entries; how these interact is unresolved. For non-spell-users, base chances are fighter 2%, paladin 6%, ranger 4%, thief 6%, assassin 5%, monk 1%, bard 3%; UA adds cavalier 5% and barbarian 1%. Add 1% per experience level and cumulative Intelligence bonuses above 12: 13–18 give +1%, +3%, +6%, +10%, +15%, +21% respectively. Treat monsters as the most applicable class. Spell-users use the detection-of-invisibility table instead.
